primary_key.description: MERGE join key — what enters the SQL ON clause. Comma-separated string or array. Every component MUST be present and non-NULL on every record; null components are how Visma v1 Bug E happened. Use `logical_keys` to document additional natural-key parts that are NOT in the MERGE ON because they may be NULL or absent.

logical_keys.description: Optional. Declares the canonical natural-key set for this entity, INCLUDING parts that are not in the MERGE ON-clause (e.g. tenant-scoping keys, optional sub-identifiers). Every component of `primary_key` should also appear here. Lets reviewers see at a glance which fields are intentionally outside the MERGE join — the Bug E lesson made config-level explicit.

enabled.description: When false, the endpoint remains documented but is excluded from normal sync/scheduler/reconcile flows.

pagination_profile.description: Runtime pagination/query profile. Finance uses pageNumber, except numbertoread_skip (numberToRead and skipRecords) for Finance endpoints that declare no pageNumber; SalesOrder and JournalTx use zero-based pageIndex; none reads the whole list in one request.

page_size.description: Endpoint-specific page size. Defaults to the adapter page size when omitted.

background_mode.description: Visma Finance background API mode. `none` sends erp-api-background:none and polls background content.

default_query.description: Static query parameters sent on every request. Arrays become repeated query parameters.

required_query.description: Query parameters that must have a value after defaults and runtime pagination/watermark values are applied.

first_period.description: First financial period (YYYYMM) that can hold data. Walked from here to the current month, one request walk per month, on every run without an explicit window.

query_params.description: Query parameters that each receive the period being fetched: fromPeriod + toPeriod for a range endpoint, periodId for a single-period one.

look_ahead_months.description: Months after the current one that are walked as well, for data posted to future periods.

resume.description: Apply the checkpoint's lastModifiedDateTime inside each period instead of re-reading every period on every run. Needs a modified_field that moves whenever a row changes.

period_field.description: Field added to every row with the period it was fetched under. Put it in primary_key when one key comes back in several periods with different content (ModulePM project transactions repeat their refNbr each month).

period_scan.description: Fetch the endpoint one financial period at a time (see PeriodScanConfig in the orchestrator).

mode.description: Build one request per cartesian product of tenant-discovered dimension values.

row_copies.description: New row field -> path of an existing field of the same row, added after the partition fields.

in_path.description: The value replaces {query_param} in api_endpoint instead of being sent as a query parameter. It is also added to every fetched row under the same name, since the API does not repeat it.

source_pagination_profile.description: Pagination profile for listing source_endpoint when it differs from the endpoint's own.

carry.description: Row field -> path in the dimension's source record; added to every row fetched for that value.

tier.description: Sync tier (1=hourly operational, 5=reference). Tier 1 is REST-only per Invariant #4.

open_set.description: Reconcile the open documents once a day per tenant, after the endpoint's hourly sync: compare the documents staging holds as open (status Open) with Visma's own list of open documents (GET <api_endpoint>?status=Open) and fetch the differences by key (GET <api_endpoint>/<primary key values in order>). Catches a payment that closes a document without moving modified_field, and a part payment that only moves its balance (compared with the balance of Visma's list row). Needs source erp_rest, tier 1, finance_page_number pagination, no partitioning or period_scan, a status field and a balance field on the documents and a key of top-level fields that is a path of the document. vsv2-validate-config enforces the same rules as the Rust registry (open_set_problem in config_validate.py). Default false. See core/crates/vsv2-orchestrator/src/open_set.rs.

notes.description: Free-form documentation for operators. No runtime impact.

pilot_override.description: Legacy flag — superseded by tenant_overrides. Ignored by orchestrator.

compare_excludes.description: Bronze fields omitted from sample shadow diffs only; not a cutover-parity waiver.
